verdicts.reason: Both break the original's symmetric parallel couplet. The first PRAY is small and pushed off to the right of 'When Life Is Rough', while the second PRAY is huge and left-aligned, so the two halves no longer mirror each other. The vertical divider now runs down the left edge instead of separating the stanzas, and the text has a ragged, inconsistent scale against the rose. A leaves 'When Life Is Great' floating midway, cut off from its PRAY. B sits it nearer its PRAY, which groups the second stanza slightly better, but the layout is still incoherent.
